name: Cb-13
summary: CB-13 (CRA13, SAB-378) is a cannabinoid drug, which acts as a potent agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors, but has poor blood–brain barrier penetration, and so produces only peripheral effects at low doses, with symptoms of central effects such as catalepsy only appearing at much higher dose ranges. It has antihyperalgesic properties in animal studies, and has progressed to preliminary human trials.

pharmacology.text: CB-13 (CRA13, SAB-378) is a cannabinoid drug, which acts as a potent agonist at both the CB1 and CB2 receptors, but has poor blood–brain barrier penetration, and so produces only peripheral effects at low doses, with symptoms of central effects such as catalepsy only appearing at much higher dose ranges.

uses.en: It is a research compound, studied as a possible painkiller acting outside the brain. It is not in medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，曾被研究作為作用於大腦以外的止痛藥候選。它沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，曾被研究作为作用于大脑以外的止痛药候选。它没有医疗用途。

fact.en: CB-13 is a naphthalene-based cannabinoid, built on a quite different frame from THC. Because it struggles to cross into the brain, it was explored as a way to treat pain in the body without the high.
fact.zh: CB-13 是以萘為基礎的大麻素，骨架與 THC 截然不同。由於它不易進入大腦，研究人員曾嘗試用它來治療身體疼痛而不產生迷醉感。
fact.zhHans: CB-13 是以萘为基础的大麻素，骨架与 THC 截然不同。由于它不易进入大脑，研究人员曾尝试用它来治疗身体疼痛而不产生迷醉感。
